in_marathi.name: Namish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Wish, Intention
in_marathi.long_meaning: Namish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Namish’ which means ‘desire’ or ‘wish’, this name is associated with the act of naming a child to give it an identity and a purpose in life. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that a child's name holds a significant influence on its future and character.
